description:
We have a new route! The Landscape of Light!

On July 25th, UNESCO included the city of Madrid as a World Heritage Site, and of course, we had to prepare this special route for you.

We have designed a route that runs through the area that encompasses the landscape of the Arts and Sciences declared a World Heritage Site, called the "Landscape of Light".

During the tour we will discover the environment of Atocha with the train station or the Ministry of Agriculture; we will pass through the Royal Observatory of Madrid; we will go inside Retiro Park to talk about some of its most emblematic places; we will walk through Jerónimos quarter to talk about the old Retiro Palace from 17th century, Jeronimos church, the Botanical Garden. And we will tour along Prado Boulevard where will see some of Madrid most important Museums, the Fountains, the Memorial to the Fallen, Cibeles square and its landmarks and palaces.
We will end up next to the monumental Alcala´s Gate, one of Madrid most well known and remarkable landmarks.
hostdescription: I am a proud Madrilenian and a licensed Tour Guide who loves the city and have grown up in the area shown in this tour. The tours involves Art, History and Nature: 3 things I am passionate to talk about.
locationDescription: In the heart of the city of Madrid, the new UNESCO recognized heritage property includes: Retiro Park, the Jerónimos neighborhood and Paseo del Prado, from Cibeles Square to Emperor Carlos V square, in Atocha. Together they form a unique urban environment, now with exceptional universal value.
